best_known_lineage.reason: Best available measured policy: 97.0% on the researcher 200-episode panel and 98.0% on the protected task-reference panel, with the residual failures confined to a single angular wedge that is reproduced in both independent panels and at both measured checkpoints. Its recorded measurements are fingerprint-bound to this artifact. It is designated best known as the strongest measured policy while development continues; terminal assessment is not requested because the researcher-panel estimate (97.0%) is not safely above the 98% objective and the systematic wedge failure makes the official-panel outcome uncertain.

code.reason: Experiment 2 changed the training target distribution (full 6-20 cm radius support plus 30% folded-required oversampling) and the combined recipe did not improve held-out performance; folded-required failures persisted (9 to 11 on the shared panel) and checkpoint-120832 added an open-feasible failure. Reverting restores the experiment-1 recipe that produced the best-known policy (TRAINING_TARGET_RADIUS_RANGE (0.14, 0.20), no folded oversampling) and removes an unsupported change from the scientific surface. The full-radius-coverage component cannot be separated from the oversampling component in this run, so the next experiment may reintroduce radius coverage as a targeted, separately tested change.

last_lineage_decision.reason: working (checkpoint-100352) remains the best measured policy. On the shared experiment-2 researcher panel (200 episodes, seed 20260918, semantics 9bbd51019e5e) it scores 191/200 = 95.5%, versus 189/200 = 94.5% for checkpoint-10240 and 188/200 = 94.0% for checkpoint-120832; paired, the parent is net +2 (2 discordant, p=0.5) and +3 (3 discordant, p=0.25). On the code-independent task-reference-v1 panel the parent is 196/200 = 98.0%, checkpoint-10240 ties at 196/200 and checkpoint-120832 is 194/200. Every researcher-panel failure of all three models is a folded-required target, and checkpoint-120832 additionally fails one open-feasible target the parent reaches, so the changed training distribution produced no improvement and slightly degraded hold stability. The parent stays the working lineage to build the next experiment on.
